summary: Build a centralized, cloud-based Growth Management App (personal Growth & Business Dashboard) for managing and optimizing 15+ D2C brands, covering performance KPIs, ads tracking, CRO, product/category, ops/shipping, AI recommendations, reporting, tasks, and a knowledge hub with secure role-based access and key API integrations.
architectural_notes: Cloud-based, mobile-friendly dashboard with a simple/clean UI.
Secure authentication with role-based access control.
Planned third-party API integrations: Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, and logistics providers (where possible).

existing_features.title: Implement secure login using Internet Identity and gate all app pages behind authentication.
Implement role-based access control (RBAC) with at least three roles (Admin, Editor, Viewer) and a basic UI for Admins to assign roles to principals.

Create the MVP information architecture and UI navigation: a responsive app shell with sidebar (desktop) / bottom navigation or drawer (mobile) and routes for Brands, Dashboard, Marketing, CRO, Products, Operations, Tasks, Reports, Knowledge, and Settings.
Brand Management: implement CRUD for brand profiles, including key fields for products/pricing/margins/suppliers/ad budget and weekly/monthly goals, with list + detail pages.

Performance Dashboard: provide a per-brand and cross-brand dashboard showing KPIs (Revenue, Profit, ROAS, CAC, Conversion rate, AOV, Return rate, Shipping cost) with time-series charts and basic trends over selectable periods (weekly/monthly).

Marketing Manager (MVP): implement a module to manually log and review Meta/Google campaign performance (campaign name, platform, spend, revenue, ROAS, dates), compare campaigns, flag underperformers based on configurable thresholds, and store associated creatives/copies as text entries and file links.
Website & CRO Module (MVP): implement a website optimization checklist per brand, an A/B test tracker (hypothesis, variants, dates, result), and a UX feedback notes log.

Product & Category Manager (MVP): implement SKU tracking per brand (SKU, category, price, cost, margin, inventory), identify best/low-performing SKUs from KPI inputs, and trigger inventory alerts using configurable thresholds.
Operations & Shipping (MVP): implement tracking for shipping partners, delivery times, RTO rate, cost per shipment, and an ops issues log per brand.

Decision & Strategy Assistant (MVP, non-LLM): generate rule-based recommendations and a weekly action plan using the app’s stored KPI thresholds and heuristics (e.g., flag low ROAS, high CAC, low conversion rate) with explanations and links to the relevant underlying data.
Reports & Presentations (MVP): implement weekly and monthly report generation per brand and cross-brand overview, with client-friendly layouts and export to PDF from the frontend.
Task & Workflow Manager: implement daily to-do list with priority tagging, due dates, reminders (in-app), and collaboration notes attached to brands or tasks.

Learning & Growth Section: implement a knowledge repository with categories (best practices, case studies, playbooks, personal notes), searchable entries, and per-entry rich text (basic formatting) and attachments as links.

Apply a cohesive, clean visual theme (not blue/purple) across the app: define a neutral analytics-style palette (e.g., charcoal, off-white, sage/teal accent), consistent typography scale, and reusable layouts for tables, metrics cards, and charts.

new_feature_requests.summary: Brand Management: create brand profiles with products, pricing, margins, suppliers, ad budgets, and weekly/monthly goals
Performance Dashboard: KPI tracking (revenue, profit, ROAS, CAC, CVR, AOV, return rate, shipping cost) with charts/trends
Marketing Manager: Meta & Google Ads tracking, campaign comparisons, budget allocation suggestions, underperformance alerts, creative/copy library
Website & CRO Module: optimization checklist, conversion suggestions, A/B test tracker, UX feedback notes
Product & Category Manager: SKU performance, inventory alerts, pricing optimization suggestions, profitability analysis
Operations & Shipping: delivery time tracking, RTO rate, shipping partners, cost per shipment, ops issues log
Decision & Strategy Assistant: AI-powered recommendations and weekly action plans across ads/pricing/CRO
Reports & Presentations: auto-generate weekly/monthly reports and client presentations with PDF/PPT export
Task & Workflow Manager: daily to-do list, priority tags, follow-up reminders, team collaboration notes
Learning & Growth Section: best practices, case studies, playbooks, and personal notes repository
Platform requirements: simple clean UI, mobile-friendly, cloud-based, secure login, role-based access, and integrations (Ads, Shopify, logistics APIs)

Create and commit project documentation describing (a) system architecture, (b) UI flow, (c) Motoko data model/storage layout, and (d) an MVP roadmap with phases and clear scope boundaries aligned to the requested modules.
